messages:
elena: Heads-up — small a11y nit with the 'Copy ID' button in Model details. NVDA/Safari: clipboard success isn't being announced. Could be confusing for keyboard users. Quick repro below.
marcus: Ack. Repro steps?
elena: Steps: 1) focus model row -> press 'Copy ID' 2) visual toast appears 3) screen reader silent (no announcement). Tested mac+VO & win+NVDA.
priya: Sounds like the toast isn't in an aria-live region. We intentionally avoided live announcements for transient toasts, but clipboard actions are important to announce.
sam: Agreed. For copy success we should explicitly announce once with a polite live region.
elena: Proposal: keep the toast visual, and also write a short string into a dedicated aria-live node (role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"). Minimal DOM mutation.
elena: Code snippet we can try:
```
// simple aria-live announcer
function announceClipboard(message) {
  const el = document.getElementById('a11y-clipboard-announcer');
  if (!el) return;
  el.textContent = message; // element has role="status" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"
}
```
priya: Nice. Also change the button's accessible name to be explicit: `aria-label=\"Copy model ID\"` so the action is clear to AT users.
marcus: Good catch. I'll add the aria-label and the announcer in a small patch.
a11y_bot: Auto-scan: contrast for toast text passes (4.6:1) but focused Copy button outline on dark theme drops to 1.9:1 — low contrast on focus ring. See attached screenshot: https://attachments/reports/clip-ani-237.png
sam: Hmm — focus ring is a separate visual issue. We should ensure minimum 3:1 for focus rings per our spec.
priya: I'll add a test that keys through the list and asserts announcer text changes and that focus state is visible (outline present and high-contrast) in both light/dark themes.
elena: I'll open a tiny PR with: (1) `aria-label` update, (2) aria-live announcer node + announce call on success, (3) tests. Assigning review to @marcus. :soon:
marcus: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4821 — added aria-label + announcer + unit test. Also included a tweak to dark theme focus color in a separate commit.
elena: Thanks — will review. Quick note: ensure we debounce announcements if users click copy repeatedly (don't spam).
priya: Good point — could set a short timeout before clearing announcer text.
elena: Also make sure we don't double-announce if toast already uses a live region. Check for existing live nodes before writing.
a11y_bot: Reminder: add e2e keyboard test in CI matrix to catch regressions.
marcus: Will include a small keyboard flow in the PR e2e suite.
elena: Cool. Marking this resolved after merge. :white_check_mark:
